Re-checking step-by-step:

Formula: Monthly Profit = (Price - Variable Cost $12) * Q - Fixed Cost $12,000
where Q = units sold = min(Demand at Price, Capacity 2000), because all unit margins are positive so make as much as you can sell up to capacity.

- $19: margin = 19-12 = 7
  Q = min(1899,2000) = 1899
  Contribution = 7 * 1899 = 13,293
  Profit = 13,293 - 12,000 = 1,293

- $24: margin = 24-12 = 12
  Q = min(2039,2000) = 2000 capped, unmet 39 lost
  Contribution = 12 * 2000 = 24,000
  Profit = 24,000 - 12,000 = 12,000

- $29: margin = 29-12 = 17
  Q = min(438,2000) = 438
  Contribution = 17 * 438 = 7,446
  Profit = 7,446 - 12,000 = -4,554

- $34: margin = 34-12 = 22
  Q = min(282,2000) = 282
  Contribution = 22 * 282 = 6,204
  Profit = 6,204 - 12,000 = -5,796

- $39: margin = 39-12 = 27
  Q = min(90,2000) = 90
  Contribution = 27 * 90 = 2,430
  Profit = 2,430 - 12,000 = -9,570

All arithmetic verified. Maximum is $24 with $12,000 profit.
